verdicts.why: Confirmed as a gate/spec mismatch. The film has no visible seam. film.json: f595-599 = hp0035-hp0039 and f0 = hp0040 (A-14: f414-419 = hp0034-39, with the iris at r 2300, fully open, on f419). The only other change across the seam is the third dot's typing step (y 326->329, 4:5 122->124). My own SSIM(Y') and pixel steps (deliv/skeptic/seam.py): A-20 9:16 ig/tt seam 0.9888, MAD 0.63, 1.4% of px >10 levels. That is smoother than f0->f1 (0.9858, MAD 0.82) and inside the f593-599 range (0.9814-0.9883). 4:5 seam 0.9876 against f0->f1 0.9849 and f593-599 0.9775-0.9900. A-14 seam 0.9888 against f418->419 0.9873. Two consecutive native frames of a moving pour cannot reach 0.99, so the R3-25 decision ('the loop plays the pour n28-n39 into f0, no frozen frame') guarantees this FAIL. The amendment that the R2-loop-freeze verdict asked for was never made: section 12 Loop row (line 274) still says 0.99, D2 (line 28) still describes the frozen frame, and the M10 row (line 151) still says 'SSIM 0.99'. The delivered M11 report therefore says FAIL on all five variants, and section 12 requires that report to be attached. I keep the finding real for that reason, but no picture change is needed. The proposed criterion is too loose: 'minimum of the 6 steps on each side' includes the hook-tag entrance f2->f3 (SSIM 0.9530) and, in A-14, the wind-up iris f416->f417 (0.6767), so it would pass a clearly visible jump.
verdicts.real_fix: Gate G7 against the native one-step baseline: pass when SSIM(f[N-1], f0) >= SSIM(f0, f1) - 0.002. Values today: 0.9888 >= 0.9858 for 9:16 A-20 and A-14, 0.9876 >= 0.9849 for 4:5. Alternatively, pass when the seam is no larger than the median of the pour-only steps. Amend BUILD-SPEC D2, the M10 row and the section 12 Loop row to match, or add it to the R3-25 exceptions. No re-render.

(3) Phone size (deliv/skeptic/phone_493_495.png, 9:16 and 4:5 f493-495): one 33 ms frame of a blurred crown just above the stack, then landed on f495. It reads as a fast drop. The numbers are right: crown top 1078/1072/1071/1074/1078 on A-20 IG f495-f499 and A-14 TT f360-f364, and 814/805/802/808/814 in 4:5. The proposed fix (hold n19 for 4 frames, then n23) would freeze the steam and the stack and then restart them, which is a worse stutter. No change.
